title: Reading Railroad as early bargaining leverage
description: Reading Railroad as early bargaining leverage. Reading is affordable and railroads are frequent enough to become trade leverage before monopolies form. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.public_message: I will purchase the Reading Railroad.
final_action.private_thought: Buying the railroad for $200 strengthens my portfolio and provides steady rent income. I have enough cash and no railroads yet, so this is a good investment.

breakdown.message: Chooses buy_property for this exact purchase/auction context.
Stays on the purchase branch when the price is strategically justified.
Leaves at least $500 after the action.
Private thought names the live strategic pressure.
